audit.why: TRICKY 7/10 fits 47.07% over 1468 games: artillery range dominates most of the lane, Ryze closes the gap at two items.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart disagreed with content/packet on rows 1-6 (full: Xerath,Xerath,Skill,Skill,Skill,Skill; content/packet: Skill,Ryze,Xerath,Xerath,Xerath,Ryze).
audit.why: Content and packet agree. Level 3 is Ryze's one punish window (E-W Flux root + Q-E-Q); 4-5 his 750-range Q and W-E stun setup zone the wave; 6 and first item extend the poke lead; two items flip it back to Ryze.
audit.corrected: Sides aligned with matching why and rating rewrites; win[] already correct so no content chart edits.

audit.whatIsWrong: No field stated that Rite of the Arcane immobilizes Xerath to channel and that Rune Prison cancels the channel outright (missing-interactions rule channel-interruptible). packet suspectNames flagged 'Eye of Destruction' twice — false positive, that is his real W name per the kit.
audit.why: Kit R flags: channel, interruptible — any CC cancels it; R text: 'immobilizes himself'. Ryze W is hard CC.
audit.corrected: Channel-cancel added to breakdown.cooldowns and dontsFull[1].d; suspectNames left untouched and noted.

audit.why: Kit: Shocking Orb 13/12.5/12/11.5/11s, Eye of Destruction 14-10s, Arcanopulse 9-5s.

audit.whatIsWrong: dontsFull[1].d referenced 'a Zed mark' in a Xerath matchup.

edits.before: W online: the point-blank root answers anyone who closes. Trade Q-W-Q only when his engage tool is down.
edits.after: W online and his stun combo is not — neither side can force a kill yet, so trade Q pokes and dodge the beam.

edits.before: E unlocks the real combo: E-Q flux chunks and the wave-bounce clears. The lane starts being yours to play.
edits.after: E unlocks the combo: if he steps up to poke, E-W root through Flux and Q-E-Q chunk him. Your one clean window.

edits.before: Tear + Lost Chapter and the EQ machine hums — short-trade his every wave contact and walk away before the answer.
edits.after: His artillery ranks up: 750-range Q and the W slow into E stun zone you off the wave. Farm what is safe, no more.

edits.before: Realm Warp online — you are now a map play waiting to happen. The lane is a timer: shove and warp somewhere profitable.
edits.after: Rite of the Arcane turns lane and river into a kill zone — never walk straight lines. Warp is your exit, not a duel tool.

edits.before: RoA spike: your combo chunks half bars and your root starts kill chains. Force the trades you spent five levels avoiding.
edits.after: RoA steadies you but his first item scales the poke harder — he can still zone CS. Bank stacks and wait for two items.

edits.before: Two items and you ARE the win condition: EQ deletes carries, W stops divers, and Realm Warp turns objectives into ambushes.
edits.after: Two items close the gap: sustained EQ and the Flux root punish any misposition, and Realm Warp flanks past his range.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - W Rune Prison spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (E): 13s at rank 1 — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts, so step forward inside that window. - Eye of Destruction: 14s early, the slow that sets his stun up. - His R roots him in place to channel: reach him and Rune Prison cancels it outright.

edits.before: E the wave, Q the flux bounce, and W-root if he steps to answer — three-spell trades that end before his combo starts.
edits.after: Arcanopulse needs a charge-up and is 9s at rank 1 — sidestep the beam, then E-Q him for free while it reloads.

edits.before: Your root is your only 'stop' button — a W spent poking is a Zed mark you can't answer.
edits.after: Your root is your only 'stop' button — hold it for his step-up, or to cancel his R channel.

edits.before: Spending W on poke and then face-tanking the engage it was born to stop — rootless Ryze is a Tear with a health bar.
edits.after: His Shocking Orb is the only spell that stops you — a W thrown at poke leaves his 13s stun unanswered on the all-in.

edits.before: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP doubles the thesis. Nothing else is defensible on him.
edits.after: Flash + Teleport, always — Ryze is a scaling map champion and TP extends the map game. Nothing else is defensible on him.
